Title: Ayaan's Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Hema - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vimla - 74 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Vihaan - 11 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
5. Isha - 13 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches
4. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Ayaan: "Today feels like a good day."

[It starts to rain.]

Hema: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Ayaan: "That's easy."

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Ayaan: "Yes, of course."

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Hema (happily): "I'm ready!"

[Snow begins to fall.]

Ayaan (gently): "Careful!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

Vihaan: "Aunty, look over here."

[Ayaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Ayaan: "This is amazing!"

[Ayaan gets into the car.]

Ayaan (surprised): "One more time!"

[Ayaan gets on the bus.]

Hema: "How beautiful!"

[Ayaan gets off the school bus.]

Ayaan: "Exactly right."

[Ayaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ayaan (surprised): "I knew it!"

Scene 3: The park - Day

Isha: "Grandma, look over here."

[Ayaan goes jogging in the park.]

Isha: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ayaan catches the ball.]

Ayaan: "Really?"

[Ayaan kicks the football hard.]

Ayaan: "That was fun!"

[Ayaan plays cricket in the park.]

Isha: "One more time!"

[Ayaan plays with his dog.]

Ayaan: "That's easy."

[Ayaan feeds the birds.]

Hema: "That's easy."

[Ayaan does yoga on a mat.]

Ayaan: "One more time!"

Scene 4: The snowy hillside - Day

Ayaan: "Let's begin."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Ayaan: "Yes, of course."

[Ayaan makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Hema (happily): "Ayaan, listen!"

[Ayaan builds a snowman.]

Ayaan (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ayaan catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Ayaan: "Okay."

[Ayaan slides down the snowy slope.]

Hema: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
